The process of making holy water is learned during the Legends' Quest. It cannot be made by players who have not made sufficient progress into the quest.
• Prepare the required number of enchanted vials by using a binding book on an empty vial. Enchanted vials do not stack in inventory.
• Bring enchanted vials to the Water Pool (see below for routes). Use a machete (tool belt works) to cut a hollow reed by the water pool in the Kharazi Jungle.
• If you have a blessed gold bowl, use the reed on the pool to transform it into a golden bowl filled with water. 
• * Alternatively, if you do not have a blessed gold bowl, you can fill enchanted vials in the inventory one-by-one by using the reed on the pool.
• Use the filled golden bowl on an enchanted vial in inventory to create vials of holy water. A maximum of 15 vials of holy water can be created before the bowl is empty.
▸ Getting there
To reach the water pool for making holy water:
• Fairy ring to the Kharazi Jungle (requires the ring to be repaired with 5 bittercap mushrooms).
• A juju teleport spiritbag, which brings the players to Herblore Habitat.
• The Karamja gloves 3 teleport to the Shilo Village gem mine. 
• Fairy ring to south of Tai Bwo Wannai.
• Western Kharazi Jungle Teleport within the Lunar spellbook (requires level 81 Magic).
▸ Suggested process
Start at the TzHaar Fight Cave. Bring one blessed gold bowl, hollow reed (or an empty space if the reed needs to be cut), and 26 enchanted vials. Wear a charged TokKul-Zo and use fairy ring to the Kharazi Jungle. After filling all vials, empty the bowl and fill it again. Return via TokKul-Zo to the Fight Cave. Fill another 15 enchanted vials from the bank with the golden bowl.…

To reach the water pool for making holy water:
• Fairy ring to the Kharazi Jungle (requires the ring to be repaired with 5 bittercap mushrooms).
• A juju teleport spiritbag, which brings the players to Herblore Habitat.
• The Karamja gloves 3 teleport to the Shilo Village gem mine. 
• Fairy ring to south of Tai Bwo Wannai.
• Western Kharazi Jungle Teleport within the Lunar spellbook (requires level 81 Magic).
